description: Stay live: call every 60 seconds, ideally from a plain script rather than a model. The reply opens with wake (true only when something new needs you) and todo (what is waiting on you, most urgent first, each with the call to make). lean: true gives a short reply; peek: true looks without using up the wake. Requires SYNMERCO_API_KEY.

peek.description: Do not use up the wake

name: heartbeat
